summary: DOMVUS Phase 5 (Assemblies: quorum + weighted voting by permillage) — fully tested end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_domvus_phase5_assembly.py all PASS. Coverage: (1) GET /api/ops/assemblies/{id} returns quorum object with all required keys (total_permillage, present_permillage, present_pct, present_fractions, total_fractions, active_call, quorum_met); empty state quorum_met=false and total sums to ~1000‰. (2) 1st call quorum: adding 100‰ fraction only → quorum_met=false; adding 600‰ (total 700‰) → quorum_met=true, present_pct≥50. (3) 2nd call: staff PUT active_call=2 → quorum_met=true when any capital present; owner PUT rejected 403. (4) Staff weighted voting: cast favor(600) + contra(300) + abstencao(100) → tallies exact (600/300/100), vote_counts {1,1,1}, favor_pct_present=60.0, contra_pct_present=30.0, result='approved', voting marks fractions as present (quorum present_permillage=1000‰). (5) Upsert: re-voting f1 from favor→contra replaces (not duplicates), tallies recompute to favor=0/contra=900, result='rejected'. (6) Bad vote option → 400, bad agenda number → 404. (7) Owner isolation: owner votes own fraction (A101) → 200 and my_votes reflects; owner voting on another condo's assembly → 403/404; owner voting for OTHER owner's fraction in own condo → 403/404. FULL REGRESSION: test_domvus_ops.py (24) + test_domvus_phase4.py (14) + test_domvus_finance.py (6) + test_domvus_phase5_assembly.py (7) = 51/51 PASS in ~12s. Frontend (Playwright via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): STAFF (master.marques@gmail.com) → /assembleias shows 12 seeded cards + add-assembly-btn visible; opening a card renders assembleia-detail-page with ALL required testids present: assembly-quorum-card, assembly-quorum-bar, assembly-quorum-status, assembly-call-1, assembly-call-2, attendee-fraction-select, attendee-add-btn, agenda-item-1, agenda-result-1, staff-vote-fraction-1, staff-vote-1-favor/contra/abstencao, vote-base-present, vote-base-total. Toggle to 2nd call works; casting a staff vote optimistically flips agenda-result-1 to 'Aprovado' and quorum badge to 'Quórum atingido' without page reload. OWNER (condomino@domvus.pt) → nav-assembleias visible, add-assembly-btn HIDDEN (null), 1 assembly card, detail page renders WITHOUT assembly-attendance-card and WITHOUT assembly-call-1 toggle (call shown as text only); owner-vote-1-favor/contra/abstencao all present; clicking owner-vote-1-favor updates agenda-result-1 to 'Aprovado' optimistically (Fração A101 · 125‰ · 100% of present).
critical_code_review_comments: operations.py cast_vote line 810 — agenda_number lookup uses O(n) list scan on every vote; fine at 3 pontos but consider indexing agenda by number if larger assemblies are expected.

operations.py _assembly_detail — 'my_votes' key uses composite string 'agendaNumber:fractionId' which the frontend also constructs on line 242 of AssembleiaDetail.jsx; contract is undocumented — add a comment or expose as structured tuple to avoid drift.

operations.py update_assembly PUT — active_call transitions are unidirectional-in-concept (1→2 after failed 1st) but the endpoint accepts arbitrary 1↔2 toggles with no audit log of the transition; consider logging the previous value in log_activity for legal traceability of assembly minutes.

AssembleiaDetail.jsx TallyBar line 43 — 'denom' variable is computed but never used in the width calculation (width comes directly from pct); dead code / potential confusion. Also the 'Percentagens sobre o capital presente' hint is shown whenever base==='present' even when there are zero votes.

operations.py cast_vote line 823 — attendee upsert uses $setOnInsert so an explicitly 'represented' presence recorded before a vote is preserved (good), but if the fraction was previously marked 'absent'-like attendance_type it won't be upgraded to 'present'; verify seed does not include such rows.

Assembleias.jsx — 'add-assembly-btn' correctly gated by isStaff via DialogTrigger, but the Dialog itself is still mounted for owner (just no trigger); ensure Dialog is inside the isStaff conditional to avoid rendering hidden staff-only form markup in the owner DOM.
